name: talk-balloon-edge
about: A speech balloon whose speaker stands near the right edge stays inside the screen, its beak on the speaker (N-1022: the Luma's call on arriving in CosmosGardenGalaxy 4 ran past the edge). The picture is judged by the gate's approved pictures (tools/gate/pictures.py), outside the repository: a picture of the game is the game's content.
